name: erp-log-nudge
description: Reminds you late on weekdays to log your ERP time when today is still empty, pointing at /generate-erp-logs

nudgeHour.title: Nudge hour
nudgeHour.description: Local hour (0-23) after which a weekday nudge may appear, once a day. Set -1 to turn nudges off.

server.title: ERP connector name
server.description: The ERP MCP server's name as /mcp lists it, or in tool-name spelling.

skill.title: Skill to run
skill.description: The slash command the nudge points at.
